d: Countryside with distant views of hills and pavilions, under which the Persian army is sleeping; starry sky with full moon. Oronte.
You can see all those hills, covered by the Macedonian army, which slowly march towards the Persians, Alexander at the head of his soldiers, Oronte who wakes up Darius' camp. Alessandro, and Oronte.
Dario's pavilion with bed, Statira crying genuflex next to his father's corpse. Statira.
Demetrius, and Perinto with Soldiers, and Statira in a melancholy act. Demetrius, Perinto, Statira.
Apelle, and Oronte disguised as Armenian.
Prison in which you can see Darius' body with a chain in the foot, large number of Persian Soldiers surrounded by strains, Statira with a black dress in a tearful act. Statira alone.
Courtyard with some Persian soldiers. Demetrius, Perinto.
Room of paintings with portraits of Statira, and Campaspe. Alessandro, Apelle.
Directing room. Alessandro, Apelle, and Campaspe.
Group of mountains with the hermitage of Statira, and mausoleum of Dario. Statira alone.
Campaspe comes out by shielding himself from the fangs of a lion and upon his arrival Apelle, and Oronte are on the fair, and finally kill him. Campaspe, Apelle, Oronte.
Wood that descends from the hermitage of Statira in a valley. Perinto with Soldiers.
Statira, and Oronte, and Perinto aside.
Grand square with triumphal arches, and royal palace in façade. Alessandro, Apelle.
Statira, Oronte, Alessandro, Demetrio, Apelle, Perinto.
Alessandro, Statira, Oronte, Apelle, Demetrio, Perinto, and Campaspe.
